instruction.text: Drag the stages of the water cycle to the correct places on the diagram.

atoms.a: Snow falls when it is very hot.
Sand is a type of precipitation.
When clouds get too full, they release their water droplets as precipitation.
Which of the following is a benefit of the water cycle?

b: ++when rain runs into rivers and streams
when the Sun shines on the side of mountains
when rain falls to the ground
++when plants give out water vapour from their leaves
when plants give out sunlight from their leaves
when plants give out snow from their leaves

instruction.text: Drag the steps of the water cycle into the correct order. Start with evaporation at the top.

atoms.text: Water warms up and then evaporates into the air.
The warm air is forced upwards, where it cools down and condenses to form clouds.
The water droplets in the clouds become bigger and then fall as precipitation.
Rainwater flows into rivers, lakes and the sea. This is called surface run-off.
